GOOD QUESTIONS. CLEAR ANSWERS.

A few things
you may be wondering.

Something else on your mind?

Ask Shakeitha ↗
Can we work together virtually?

Yes. You can book a virtual appointment and use the TaxesToGo referral link for tax intake. After scheduling, follow the appointment instructions for your next steps.

Do you work with small business owners?

Yes. Services include tax preparation, bookkeeping, business formation guidance, payroll, financial reporting, and budgeting. Book a conversation to discuss the support that fits your business.

How much will my service cost?

Pricing depends on the service and complexity of your needs. Contact SLS Accu-Books to discuss the scope and request a quote before you proceed.

How should I share my tax documents?

Use the designated secure intake service provided for your engagement. Please do not send Social Security numbers, tax forms, or other sensitive financial information through ordinary email.

What if I'm not sure which service I need?

Use the service finder above or book an appointment. We'll discuss your goals and determine the appropriate next step together.
